name: roundhouse
description: Capture intent in the Roundhouse Depot, answer durable questions, and inspect work status.

interface.shortDescription: Send intent to the Depot and resolve material questions.
interface.longDescription: Implementation requests become durable Depot items. Roundhouse owns triage, human decisions, readiness, internal executor selection, verification, and delivery; this plugin never exposes a direct execution bypass.
defaultPrompt: Is anything in Roundhouse waiting on me?
What is the status of my Roundhouse work?
